meta.story: Bablu ka Hotel (English): the hotel across the street is full because it posts every day; Priya says they posted once in March; Kaka says let someone write, make and post it for you while you just approve on your phone (Velocity); replies and guest messages come to the phone; Bablu fully booked
meta.hook: Our food is better. So why are we *empty*?

beats.label: BABLU'S HOTEL · EP 4
beats.headline: Our food is better. So why are we *empty*?
beats.say: Our food is better. So why is that hotel full... and we are empty?

beats.label: PRIYA · RECEPTION
beats.say: Sir, they post on Instagram every single day. We posted once... in March.

beats.label: 1 · POSTS WRITTEN FOR YOU
beats.say: Then let someone do it for you, beta. They write your posts,

beats.label: 2 · YOU APPROVE ON YOUR PHONE
beats.say: make the videos, and post on time. You just say yes, on your phone.

beats.label: 3 · REPLIES TO COMMENTS FOR YOU
beats.say: And it replies to comments, and every guest message comes straight to our phone. Nothing goes out without your okay, sir.

beats.label: SEND THIS TO A HOTEL OWNER
beats.say: Fully booked this weekend... and I did not write a single post!
